items.quote: "Their strategy and creative direction helped scale the channels quickly, generating millions of views, strong engagement, and a clear, premium identity."

Glasshouse completely understands what makes a brand feel relevant on social. They’ve helped us create a clearer, more confident presence that still feels unmistakably Hip & Healthy: just sharper, more engaging and built to grow.

workPage.label: Work
workPage.heading: Brands people wanted to be part of.
workPage.nextHeading: The brand already has a story. Our job is to make people want to step inside.

servicesPage.label: Services
servicesPage.heading: Strategy, content and community — under one roof.
servicesPage.lede: We can run everything, or slot into the part you're missing. Most clients start with one service and open the rest of the house over time.

steps.title: Audit and strategy
steps.text: Two to three weeks. We go through the account, the competitors and the audience, and come back with content pillars, a tone of voice and the numbers we are aiming at.

steps.title: Make the work
steps.text: Filming days, editing, design. We build a bank of content before anything goes live, so the account never runs on whatever was to hand that week.

steps.title: Run and report
steps.text: Daily publishing and community management, monthly reporting against the KPIs we set, and a standing call. What worked gets made again; what did not gets said out loud.

servicesPage.faqHeading: The things people ask before the first call.
servicesPage.faqNote: If yours is not here, ask it directly — we would rather answer than have you guess.

aboutPage.label: About
aboutPage.heading: Inside the Glasshouse.
aboutPage.lead: Welcome to the Glasshouse. We create social strategies that invite people inside, building brands by making audiences feel part of the story.
aboutPage.para1: We don't just grow audiences, we cultivate communities that thrive in the open. Our campaigns are built with clarity and creativity, turning moments into movements and stories into spaces people belong to.
aboutPage.para2: From rising entrepreneurs to global lifestyle brands, we help our clients break barriers, shine brighter, and expand their reach without losing authenticity. At the Glasshouse, growth is transparent, human, and impossible to ignore.
aboutPage.peopleNote: Three of us, full time. Beyond that we work with a regular bench of freelance editors, photographers and motion designers - briefed by us, never handed off. See who we're looking for →

careersPage.label: Careers
careersPage.heading: Come inside.
careersPage.para1: We're a small team that ships a lot. Everyone here writes, films, edits or strategises — often all four in a week. You'll work directly with founders and directly with clients, from day one.
careersPage.para2: We hire for taste and curiosity over years of experience. If you can explain why something worked, you're already most of the way there.
careersPage.freelanceText: We keep a working list of editors, photographers, motion designers and community managers. Send a reel or a folder — that's enough.
careersPage.openText: No suitable role listed? Tell us what you'd want to do here and what you'd want to be paid to do it.

contactPage.label: Contact
contactPage.sublabel: We reply within two working days
contactPage.heading: The door's open.
contactPage.lede: Have a brand, a brief, or just a feeling that your socials could be doing more? Tell us about it.
contactPage.formNote: No automated sequence. A person reads it and replies.
contactPage.needLabel: What do you need help with?
contactPage.next1: We read it properly and reply within two working days.
contactPage.next2: A thirty-minute call to understand the brand and what good looks like.
contactPage.next3: A proposal with scope, timings and numbers attached.
contactPage.doneHeading: Thank you — that has reached us.
contactPage.doneText: We read everything that comes in and reply within two working days.
contactPage.notWired: This form is not connected yet — please email us directly and we will pick it up.
